verdict.rationale: An IP office with an online filing rail could reasonably publish its account, credential and identity-proofing prerequisites up front, so this axis applies. The evidence confirms e-filing services exist, a "Before You Apply" section, a filing-process basics page, and published fees and forms. However, none of the cited items describe account registration, login credentials, digital-signature or identity-verification requirements before filing; the status-lookup item covers status search, not filing.
